notes: rk-5lzf (Tier A, LB5): the ZERO-ROWS false-green. A `translations:` key written in the frontmatter is swallowed by `parseFrontmatter`'s block-list handling (rk-wc3), which joins `- item` lines into one ';'-separated string — so the body scan finds no rows, every translation check passes vacuously, and the coverage line reads a perfectly clean `0/0 translations verified`. This is the same shape as dogfood-2's silent-empty-`deps:` incident (`linker-29`), and the same remedy: the vacuous state is made loud instead of being inferred as compliance. Note the coverage line in this fixture is honestly 0/0 — the fixture's whole point is that the DENOMINATOR is the thing that went missing, which is why the finding, not the count, has to carry it.
